about: The Workbench icons of the Rott drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is Taradino's own 32x32 icon (misc/taradino.png, GPL 2 or later like the program), enlarged twice. Rott-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Rott.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Rott.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-taradino, COPYING.txt, Licences.txt and Cheats.txt.
